title: Hanasato Minori — Wh-Wh-Wh-What?!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Pre-release♪ Pre-release♪
Pre-release today♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(After practice would be too late.
I should grab what I can before I go!)

rows.Speaker: Man's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, you...! You, over there!
Interested in becoming an idol?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Huh?! Am I being scouted?!)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Um... Are you talking to me?

rows.Speaker: Man's Voice
rows.Line: Yes! Here's my card. I'm actually a...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh, okay...
He was asking the girl behind me...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is she the same age as me...?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Hm? You must be a friend of theirs.
Are you here for a tour of the agency?

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line: Our agency would be happy to take you, Ms. Hinomori and Ms. Momoi, but I was not aware you would be bringing an amateur with you as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've always been told that I was dull or lackluster during auditions...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I guess you really need to have an aura, like Haruka, to become a fully-fledged idol...)
After practice
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Practice felt really productive today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was. As our practice sessions get better, the rate of our improvement will too and... Wait, where's Minori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's right there... By that shop's display window.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My bangs should look like... There! I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you so worried about how you look today, Minori? Is something going on?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! There's something I need to do so...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'll be heading out first!
Bye, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She went off in a hurry...
Did something happen to her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It should be around here... The street where scouts look for potential models and idols.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Let's do this...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(My makeup, outfit and hair are flawless.
Now, I need to walk like I mean business...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Come forth, my sparkly aura! One that can captivate anybody in an instant, like Haruka!)

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: Oh, you there! Do you have some time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh! Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sigh... She wanted me as a hair model. Not an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but maybe that means I managed to emit some kind of aura!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright! I just have to keep trying then...!
Hello...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! How may I...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whaaa?! Haruka...?!
Everyone?! What're you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You didn't seem like yourself just now, so we came to see if everything was okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: D-Does that mean... You saw everything...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We saw you walking around like you were desperately looking for something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you still feeling self-conscious about that whole idol aura thing...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Err...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You dummy. I told you not to worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't quote me on this, but I don't think this aura you're thinking of is something you consciously give off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It could just be that your ability to shine has just reached its infancy too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, in your case, it may take you a little longer than usual to reach the final stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if that's the case, we'll look for it together, Minori. A way for you to truly shine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka... Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right...
You're absolutely right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you really think so, then stop trying to get scouted like this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're more likely to get ripped off by some sketchy salesman selling expensive school supplies before a talent scout finds you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's not true!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Besides, I fully intend on becoming an idol with MORE MORE JUMP!, regardless of whether or not I get scouted!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, so let's work on that together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I feel much better...
But I'm starting to feel a bit hungry too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wanna grab a bite at a cafe before heading back?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's go!
